import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 本命物升级指令（消耗筑灵石提升等级）
 *
 * 用法：本命物升级 [级数]
 *   - 本命物升级      → 升 1 级
 *   - 本命物升级 5    → 升 5 级
 *   - 本命物升级 36   → 一键升到满级（36级）
 */
import App from '@src/response-apps/soulArtifact/upgrade/app';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { createQuoteMarkdown, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;

  const text = e.MessageText?.trim() ?? '';
  const match = text.match(/^[!！/#＃]?本命物升级\s*(\d+)?$/);
  const levels = match?.[1] ? Math.max(1, Number(match[1])) : 1;

  const result = await App({ bid, uid, levels, messageText: e.MessageText, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });

  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  const displayMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, uid, e.MessageText, result.data.message, createBackendRequestContext(e));

  md.addText(displayMsg);
  if (result.code === 'OK' && result.data.compareLines.length > 0) {
    md.addNewline();
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('升级前后');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addBlockquote(createQuoteMarkdown(result.data.compareLines.map(line => ` ${line}`)));
  }
  const actionMd = Format.createMarkdown().addText('继续升级： ');

  actionMd.addButton('再升×1', { data: '/本命物升级' });
  actionMd.addText(' ').addButton('再升×5', { data: '/本命物升级 5' });
  actionMd.addText(' ').addButton('再升×36', { data: '/本命物升级 36' });
  actionMd.addText(' ').addButton('我的本命物', { data: '/本命物信息' });
  md.addBlockquote(actionMd);

  void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
});
